input.question: Why does it take hours to install big programs and games but seconds to uninstall it?
input.ground_truth: When you are installing a game, you are writing the files to your hard drive. It has to remember where to access those files. The uninstallation is just forgetting those locations on your drive, not actually erasing them.

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: Why does it take hours to install big programs and games but seconds to uninstall it?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay, let’s imagine you have a big toy box. 

When you want to **put toys into the box**, you have to pick up each toy one by one and carefully put them inside. That takes a long time because there are a lot of toys!

But when you want to **take all the toys out of the box**, you just open the box and dump them out. That happens really fast!

Installing a big program or game is like putting all the toys into the box—one piece at a time. Uninstalling is like taking all the toys out at once, which is much quicker. That’s why it takes hours to install but only seconds to uninstall!
